limit.description: Number of markets returned, biggest move first: integer from 1 to 50. Default: 20.

platform.description: Platform: polymarket or kalshi (lower case). Default: both platforms.

window.description: Length of the window, which ends at the data cutoff: 1h, 6h, 24h or 7d. Default: 24h.
